$comment: Which files of the mirobody repository become pages of the Open Source tab.
scripts/sync-oss.mjs renders each `source` (at the commit oss.lock pins) into en/<slug>.mdx.
zh/<slug>.mdx comes from `zhSource` when the repository has a Chinese edition; with
"zh": "translation" it is a hand-written translation kept in this repository (its
frontmatter `source:` records the commit it was translated from, see check:freshness);
otherwise the zh page shows the English text under a notice.
Sidebar order and grouping live in docs.json, like every other page.

description.en: Install the Python library or start the application, then try your first query.
description.zh: 安装 Python 库或启动应用，完成第一次查询。

description.en: Hardware requirements, platform setup and connection checks for local models.
description.zh: 准备硬件，按平台启动本地模型，并检查连接。

description.en: Choose local, cloud or hybrid processing by hardware and data privacy.
description.zh: 根据硬件和数据隐私要求选择本地、云端或混合方案。

description.en: Upload a report, inspect results, ask questions and record a journal entry.
description.zh: 上传报告、核对结果、提问并记录健康日记。

description.en: How source data becomes standardized records and cited answers.
description.zh: 原始资料如何整理成标准化记录，并用于有来源的回答。

description.en: Configure credentials and callbacks for Garmin, Oura and WHOOP.
description.zh: 配置 Garmin、Oura、WHOOP 的凭据与回调，检查同步状态。

description.en: Supported documents, upload status, extracted readings and API entry points.
description.zh: 支持的文档格式、上传状态、读数核对与 API 接入。

description.en: Import a Health export or receive records from an authorized client.
description.zh: 导入健康 App 导出包，或接收已授权客户端推送的数据。

description.en: Resolve names and compatible units offline, with explicit unknown results.
description.zh: 离线解析指标名称和兼容单位，保留无法确定的结果。

description.en: Look up device fields and understand verified, unverified and unmapped results.
description.zh: 查询设备字段，区分已确认、待确认与无标准映射的结果。

description.en: Import genotype files, query recorded calls and understand coverage limits.
description.zh: 导入基因型文件、查询检出结果，并了解覆盖范围。

description.en: Choose a record tool, select a query view and interpret partial results.
description.zh: 选择数据工具与查询视图，理解来源及不完整结果。

description.en: Configure local Python calculation on original query results.
description.zh: 配置本地 Python 计算，直接使用查询返回的原始数据。

description.en: Record plans, review courses and query reported doses.
description.zh: 记录用药计划、查看疗程，并查询已记录的服药情况。

description.en: Register a Python tool and handle authenticated record access.
description.zh: 注册 Python 工具，并正确处理用户身份和记录访问权限。

description.en: Install workflows for using the library or connecting a coding assistant.
description.zh: 安装库调用或应用接入技能，供编码助手使用。

description.en: Implement the provider contract, register an integration and verify its data.
description.zh: 实现 provider 接口、注册集成，并验证数据处理。

description.en: Back up the database and files, preserve keys and rehearse recovery.
description.zh: 备份数据库和文件，保管密钥，并演练恢复。
